purpose: Preserve original 创智龙 identity; concept only; earlier generic robot and human proposals discarded

concepts.title: 01 · 创智龙机器人
concepts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept.
Make a new game sculpture concept of THE EXACT DRAGON IN REFERENCE IMAGE 1. This is an identity-locked adaptation, not a new character design.
Reference 1 is the ABSOLUTE identity source. Reference 2 is the town environment and painting style. Do not use any previously generated designs.
The client explicitly rejected redesigns that no longer look like 创智龙. They must recognize their OWN dragon instantly. Trace its signature proportions carefully: oversized round white head; broad asymmetrical branching COBALT BLUE antlers with rounded tips; large round BLUE CLOUD-SCALLOP mane behind the head; the distinctive thick pale-blue wraparound GOGGLE frame across the white forehead and around cheeks; large oval blue eyes with deep blue pupils and white catchlights; tiny peach triangular nose; small curved smiling mouth; rounded side ears; plump short chibi body, about 2.1 heads tall; curled tail with amber flame shape. Preserve exact relationships and silhouette. DO NOT replace the dragon face with two light bars. DO NOT remove the goggles, cloud mane or natural-shaped antlers. No human head, human hair, generic service robot head, new mascot, oval astronaut helmet, armor knight, deities, crowns, halos, floating spheres, gold or ornamental gems.
Art style: same clear, bright, clean, lightly painted game illustration as reference 2; integrated 2.5D shadows and restrained highlights, not glossy product photography or 3D toy advertising. Blue, white, cream stone, warm amber tail. No grunge.
Layout: landscape 3:2, left 47% large full-body three-quarter sculpture concept isolated on warm off-white, right 53% in-world view of the identical sculpture beside the rear edge of the existing sunken plaza. Entire statue and small base visible; feet planted; sunlight and perspective match the environment. The statue is 1.8 times the standard resident height. Include ONE small unchanged source dragon in its original white hoodie and blue shorts nearby for easy direct identity comparison. Most plaza area is open. Title at upper-left only as specified, no other text.

Text (verbatim): "01 · 创智龙机器人".
Apply a coherent ALL-ROBOT construction to the exact source dragon WITHOUT changing its shape. The entire original dragon FACE including white face background, SAME large blue eyes, tiny nose and small smile is displayed as one clean high-resolution flat digital facial graphic on an inset face-shaped screen. This is an exact likeness of the source face rendered on a single screen, not a human/animal muzzle attached to a robot. The original distinctive pale-blue GOGGLES are a physical continuous rim around this screen. There is no fleshy snout or skin anywhere.
Original branching antlers are molded matte cobalt antenna housings in EXACT source shape. Original cloud mane is one unified smooth scalloped blue shell, no fur or separate random cloud ornaments. Original ears are two manufactured round side housings preserving source outline. All surfaces have same cohesive enamel metal material and simple construction. Body retains the SOURCE CHIBI PROPORTIONS, but is a unified cream shell torso with a navy center seam echoing source hoodie's drawstrings, simple cobalt hip shell, small round metal arms/legs and familiar white shoes with blue soles. Dark navy pivots small and unobtrusive. Tail follows original curve, segmented rigid blue-white shell and translucent orange flame-shaped lamp. No painted blush on casing. No extra head antennas. One tiny blue chest status light only.
Pose standing, head slightly inclined, one hand open in welcome, other arm resting. Low plain cream stone base. Clear robot fabrication, NO humanoid tall armored anatomy. Screen face keeps the original dragon likeness fully.

Text (verbatim): "02 · 创智龙雕塑".
Make a fully SCULPTED anthropomorphic dragon statue preserving the source character entirely, with absolutely ZERO mechanical parts. This is the source white-and-blue dragon itself immortalized in a public sculpture: same head, same goggles, same face, same mane, same proportions, same white hoodie with two dark drawstrings, same blue shorts and simple white sneakers. Do not invent a human character. The hoodie and clothes are part of the single solid sculptural artwork, not actual fabric.
Material: finely crafted matte ivory cast ceramic with clean cobalt and pale-blue glazed areas, integrated soft sculpted planes, all surfaces share one refined ceramic material. Eyes and face have exact original graphic shapes painted into glaze; no realistic skin or fur. Sturdy but clean silhouette, no grime. No visible bolts, metal joints, face screen, armor panels or sci-fi gadget.
Pose: perched on a simple low cream stone seat, leaning forward slightly as if listening to a student; a small CLOSED blue book held naturally against the lap by one hand, other hand lightly resting on the seat beside it, gentle reassuring original dragon smile. Bent short legs and original sneakers supported on lower step, curled flame tail beside seat. Keep relaxed intelligent personality, no giant exaggerated eyes or mouth, no grandiose god pose. Base/seat plain and modest, one small empty portion for a visitor to sit. The sculpture belongs to the original world and is instantly recognizable as the original mascot.
